title: Convert to No Charge sends work_order.updated with the lines
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks the Open API story of Internal Work Orders (SV-11833), which is built after the Open API refactoring and does not ship with the core release. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11833 is released.

Preconditions

  • Use an Open API key for the test organization, the Open API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a webhook subscription for the test organization pointed at a request-catching page the tester can read. Subscribe it to work_order.updated.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved.
custom_steps:
1. In ShopView, convert work order 1 to No Charge under Goodwill.
  2. Open the request-catching page to read the webhook requests.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 shows the "No Charge" badge.

Step 2:

  • work_order.updated arrived with work order 1 and its lines in the body.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11833 (Story 11, Open API and webhooks)

  • S11-R3: “Webhooks: work_order.status_changed is sent at Close with the status closed and at Reopen with the status completed (today it is sent at completion only, so Close on a work order that is already Complete is a new emission). invoice.created and invoice.paid are never sent for an internal invoice; that part ships with the core release (S3-R4). Proposed for the API owner to confirm: Convert to No Charge, Convert to Billable and Change category on a work order, Mark as No Charge, Change category and Mark as Billable on a line, and a change of the shop supplies amount send work_order.updated (defined in the catalogue today, never emitted) with the work order and its lines in the body; no new event type and no line-level webhook. The API owner also reviews the line fields of S11-R1.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
